authoring_process.finding: Town concepts/events preceded final geometry/program; maps, dialogue and status systems were iterated as specifications.
authoring_process.dolzore_rule: Require TownConcept contract before final map art.

field_encounters.finding: Visible field enemies integrate navigation and battle; contact direction affects advantage; trivial weak encounters can bypass normal battle display.
field_encounters.dolzore_rule: Use visible threats, contact-context battle state and original fast-resolve logic.

rolling_hp.finding: Analog/drum HP creates a reaction window inside command-driven combat.
rolling_hp.dolzore_rule: If desired, build an original delayed-consequence health mechanic; do not copy the drum UI.

road_movie.finding: Scenery, food, rest and music were treated as travel experience; pleasant recovery space could precede harsh travel.
road_movie.dolzore_rule: Author recovery-value areas and journey pacing, not only combat difficulty.

stateful_dialogue.finding: Dialogue included rare conditional states and substantial post-event/endgame reactions.

visual_style.finding: Art direction intentionally prioritized design/readability over literal realism and relied on compact reusable materials.
visual_style.dolzore_rule: Use coherent symbolic art, modular pieces and authored exceptions.

audio.finding: Music was evaluated by scene fit and could range from accessible pop-like material to experimental battle/strange-area textures.
audio.dolzore_rule: Define AudioRole/AudioIdentity by dramatic function rather than one track per generic category.

memory.finding: Different players retain different small fragments—words, sounds, scenes, discomfort, humor, emotion.
memory.dolzore_rule: Seed optional multi-sensory MemoryAnchor content beyond critical path.

principles: semantic place concept before geometry
connected journey illusion with sectorized implementation
density modulation instead of uniform maximal density
everyday civic functions establish normality
coherent oddity nodes create local identity
roads are pacing corridors
landmarks use multiple sensory/social channels
interiors are compact semantic spaces
places persist and react to events
field enemies are navigation obstacles/choices
original_quality_targets: at least one primary loop per town where scale permits
at least three optional memory anchors before final town art lock
major landmarks discoverable through world and map UI

principles: identity first by silhouette/color/motion, facial pixels last
character/world scale must be shared with doors, vehicles and props
sprite art and collider are separate
reusable modular art is composed into local variety
special worlds can transform familiar geometry via materials/palette/behavior/audio
battle motion can be parameterized/procedural instead of frame-heavy
quality_gates: critical UI never obscured by effects

principles: scene fit over generic music categories
audio participates in place identity
style contrast can strengthen identity
recovery zones need lower-stress sonic profiles
experimental audio should be meaningful and rare enough to register
ambience and object-bound sound are as important as BGM
silence is a designed state
trivial fast-resolved encounters should avoid full battle-music friction
do not imitate a living/recognizable writer's prose
weirdness works because mundane life is established first
humor must come from character/situation rather than nonstop jokes
NPCs need local point of view beyond quest function
repeated interactions may transform
post-event dialogue makes the world persistent
vulnerability humanizes protagonists
small optional interactions create player-specific memory
localization should preserve intent/effect, not literal wording alone

findings.map_grid: tool model exposes 256 x 320 map entries
findings.tile_model: 8x8 graphic minitiles composed into larger arrangements; tool model separates collision
findings.sprite_group: palette, dimensions, direction/mirroring and directional collision metadata are separate
findings.enemy_placement: enemy group definition separate from geographic placement
findings.doors: transition/destination data separate from map art
findings.map_music: music selection can vary by event flag
findings.battle_background: tile/palette/arrangement plus separate scroll and distortion parameters

technical_reverse_engineering.interpretation_warning: Reverse-engineered tool structure is not proof of original source-code class architecture.
